text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen. First, you need to recognize risks, such as losing money, facing delays, or dealing with technical failures. Once you know the risks, you can create mitigation strategies to reduce their impact. For example, you might buy insurance or train your team better. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you use if things go wrong. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. By following these steps, you can protect your project and make better decisions.
